---
title: "Chart viewer"
---

Use `askr-chart-view` for an interactive chart exported as a trusted local HTML
file. It displays the chart in the article or opens it from a button, with an
optional floating view. The chart keeps its own hover, zoom, pan and reset
controls. See the [working mathematical example](../components/chart-viewer.qmd).

## Embed a chart

Export the chart as a self-contained HTML file with its required JavaScript
included, then reference it relative to the `.qmd` document:

```markdown
{{{< askr-chart-view src="images/chart.html" label="Inspect the chart" >}}}
```

`mode="inline"` is the default. The frame fits the article width and includes
an Expand control. For an entry that only opens a floating window:

```markdown
{{{< askr-chart-view src="images/chart.html" mode="button" label="Open chart" >}}}
```

`src` identifies the local `.html` file; remote URLs are not accepted. `label`
names the chart or button so readers can distinguish multiple entries, and
defaults to `View chart`. Use `inline` or `button` for `mode`.

If the Askr viewer script is unavailable, the inline frame and source link
remain available; a button-only entry remains a link to the HTML. Chart
interaction still requires the export's own JavaScript. Non-HTML outputs link
to that source file.

Serve the rendered site over HTTP(S), using Quarto preview or a local static
server, to enable the floating viewer. Opening the page through `file://` keeps
the native inline frame and source-link behavior. Only the HTML file is copied
automatically; for exports with companion scripts or data, declare those files
in native `project.resources`, or use a self-contained export.

## Choose the content

| Delivered content | Component |
| --- | --- |
| Static SVG, PNG or JPEG | [Image viewer](image-viewer.qmd) supplies image zoom, pan and Fit. |
| Interactive HTML chart | Chart viewer keeps the chart's own interaction. |
| Native Mermaid diagram | The [Mermaid viewer](image-viewer.qmd#mermaid-viewer) opens its rendered diagram with image controls. |

Askr supplies an iframe and floating-window shell. It does not install Plotly
or another plotting engine into the theme. Authors produce the HTML using
their chosen chart tool and include its runtime resources. The Gallery's sine
curve bundles Plotly only inside its demonstration file; it is not an Askr
extension dependency.

## Trust, theme and state

Use HTML you authored or reviewed. The chart runs scripts as a same-origin
part of your site, so treat it as active website content. Inspect the file and
its resource requests before publishing; an external script or data request in
that HTML remains the author's responsibility.

The frame and window controls follow the Askr light/dark theme. The chart
retains the colors and labels selected by its author. Prepare any alternative
chart theme in the chart itself rather than expecting Askr to recolor it.

The inline and floating frames have independent state. Opening the floating
view loads its own chart; closing it leaves the inline view's current state in
place. No shared zoom, selection or data state is promised. Use the chart's own
controls to inspect data, then close the floating window or press Escape to
return to the article.
